auditTitle: MULTIPATH V3 — Comprehensive Student-Journey Functional & UX Audit

gitBaseline.workingTreeStatus: untracked audit artifacts only, zero modifications

tests.description: Verify homepage load, hero copy, trust metrics, and primary call-to-actions
reproductionSteps: 1. Navigate to https://multipath-one.vercel.app/
2. Inspect title, eyebrow badge, hero headline, and CTA buttons
tests.notes: Loaded instantaneously with zero layout shift. Clean dark theme styling.

tests.description: Inspect Auth Modal, offline notice badge, guest learner continuity, and modal dismissal
reproductionSteps: 1. Click 'Guest Mode' / profile button in navbar
2. Observe modal fields and notice badge
3. Verify modal dismissal via backdrop and close icon
4. Confirm unauthenticated guest can access all learning features
tests.notes: Zero paywall. Gracefully falls back to local IndexedDB guest mode when Supabase is unconfigured.

tests.description: Inspect board selectors (CBSE vs CISCE/ICSE), class selectors (Classes 6-10), and syllabus codes
reproductionSteps: 1. Click 'Library' in navbar
2. Toggle Board between CBSE and ICSE/CISCE
3. Observe dynamic syllabus citation badge swaps (e.g. CBSE 086 vs CISCE)
tests.notes: Catalog displays 64 topics across 8 academic disciplines with exact statutory board citations.

tests.description: Test real-time query filtering with keyword 'Reaction' and 'Force'
reproductionSteps: 1. Enter search input on Library page
2. Type 'Reaction'
3. Verify cards filter immediately from 64 to 7 topics
4. Clear and type 'Force', verifying 11 matched topics
tests.notes: Instant debounced client-side filtering matching titles, concepts, and syllabus units.

tests.description: Inspect 4 parallel epistemic mode cards, cognitive descriptions, and format switching
reproductionSteps: 1. Select topic 'phys-newtons-laws'
2. Inspect the 4 mode cards in top hero
3. Click between 'Structured Explanation', 'Visual Learning', 'Examples & Applications', and 'Explore & Experiment'
tests.notes: Zero page reload. Clear target learner descriptions ('FOR: Learners who ask What does this look like?').

tests.description: Evaluate Newton's Laws of Motion orientation, first-principles derivation, and prerequisite structure
reproductionSteps: 1. Open topic phys-newtons-laws
2. Select 'Structured Explanation'
3. Read orientation, core inquiry questions, prerequisite definitions, and step-by-step law breakdowns
tests.notes: Exceptional pedagogical rigor. Defines inertia as intrinsic matter property rather than a force.

tests.description: Inspect 3D Topological Invariant Network and physical force equilibrium nodes
reproductionSteps: 1. Toggle to 'Visual Learning' mode on Newton's Laws
2. Click network nodes (Inertial Mass, Dynamic Net Force, Reciprocal Action-Reaction)
3. Observe reactive topological focus
tests.notes: WebGL renders smoothly without frame drops. Node inspection updates underlying invariant card.

tests.checkpoint: Checkpoint D — Concept 1 Socratic Diagnostic Engine
tests.description: Submit incorrect hypothesis and scientifically correct answer to test 4-tier diagnostic feedback
reproductionSteps: 1. Open Socratic inquiry prompt on friction in deep space
2. Submit incorrect answer: 'motion naturally runs out of energy'
3. Verify diagnostic feedback 'Clarification Needed' and guiding question
4. Submit correct Newton's First Law response
5. Verify 'Mastery Verified' badge and milestone progression
tests.notes: Constructive, formative feedback instead of binary right/wrong flag.

tests.checkpoint: Checkpoint D — Concept 2 Linear Equations Workbench
tests.description: Test Linear Equations Slope-Intercept & Pan Balance Interactive Workbench with live presets and sliders
reproductionSteps: 1. Open topic math-linear-equations
2. Switch to 'Explore & Experiment' mode
3. Toggle Cartesian Plane vs Pan Balance views
4. Select preset 'Direct Proportion (y = 3x)'
5. Observe pan balance scale achieving 0-degree equilibrium at 6kg
tests.notes: Bridges symbolic equation 3x = 6 to physical equilibrium and coordinate geometry (2, 6).

tests.checkpoint: Checkpoint D — Concept 2 Feynman Diagnostic Simulation
tests.description: Engage learner persona Alex in Feynman Teach-to-Learn mode, verify dynamic multi-turn dialogue
reproductionSteps: 1. Scroll to Feynman 'Teach to Consolidate' module
2. Read Alex's prompt regarding balance scale and inverse operations
3. Type explanation explaining 3x+7=22 balance
4. Verify Alex's response acknowledging inverse operations and asking follow-up on variables on both sides
tests.notes: Creates authentic pedagogical dialogue simulating peer tutoring.

tests.checkpoint: Checkpoint D — Concept 2 Six-Dimension Mastery Rubric
tests.description: Evaluate 'Assess My Explanation' output across 6 cognitive dimensions with verbatim quote grounding
reproductionSteps: 1. Click 'Assess My Explanation' in Feynman lab
2. Inspect rubric ratings: Accuracy, Completeness, Understanding, Relationships, Terminology, Reasoning
3. Verify demonstrated vs unexamined concept analysis
tests.notes: Produces actionable feedback identifying specific demonstrated theorems and missing areas.

tests.description: Verify IndexedDB guest telemetry tracking across multiple topics and activity logging
reproductionSteps: 1. Click 'My Learning' in navbar
2. Verify 'Topics Explored: 3/64', 'Paths Explored: 4/4'
3. Inspect Discipline Progress Matrix (Math 7%, Physics 8%, Biology 10%)
4. Verify Chronological Learning Activity Ledger shows 15 logged events with timestamps
tests.notes: Includes full JSON Vault export and audit trail.

tests.checkpoint: Checkpoint E — Workspace URL State Synchronization
tests.description: Test hard page reload (F5 / page.reload()) while on a topic workspace
reproductionSteps: 1. Navigate to topic 'math-linear-equations' in Workspace
2. Trigger browser hard reload (F5)
3. Observe active view resets to Home rather than preserving active topic URL parameter
tests.notes: DEFECT-ROUTING-01: Router state is kept in memory and IndexedDB rather than synchronized with URL search params (e.g. /?topic=math-linear-equations). Clicking 'Learning Workspace' tab immediately reloads topic from memory, but direct refresh requires one extra click.

tests.description: Inspect mobile viewport (375x812) layout, touch targets, and contrast compliance
reproductionSteps: 1. Switch viewport to 375x812
2. Verify navbar collapses cleanly
3. Verify cards stack vertically with zero horizontal scroll overflow
4. Verify contrast of lime text (#E2F952) and white typography on dark background (#080A0E)
tests.notes: WCAG AA compliant contrast ratio. Clean responsive vertical stacking.
